extracted.summary: The Parivartan ECSS Programme provides financial assistance to excellent students from impoverished backgrounds who are aspiring for a greater future.
extracted.amount_text: Classes 1 to 6: INR 15,000. Classes 7 to 12, Diploma, ITI and Polytechnic: INR 18,000. Undergraduate General: INR 30,000. Undergraduate Professional: INR 50,000. Postgraduate General: INR 35,000. Postgraduate Professional: INR 75,000.
extracted.min_percentage_quote: A minimum of 55% marks in the previous qualifying examination is required.
extracted.max_family_income_quote: The annual family income should be less than or equal to INR 2.5 lakh.
extracted.course_levels_quote: Applicants must be students in Classes 1 to 12, diploma, ITI, polytechnic, undergraduate or postgraduate courses in recognized institutions.
